Method of Attack: Hijacking abandoned third-party script by registering the same AWS S3 bucket name and replacing the legitimate script with a malicious version that redirects users to scam sites
Malicious event handler triggers on user pressing the back button, redirecting to scam URL
Impacted Systems: Over 800 websites embedding the abandoned New Share Counts script
Attack Vector: Hijacked AWS S3 bucket hosting the third-party script
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious nsc.js script uploaded to hijacked S3 bucket
